Display Color Analyzer CA-410
Product catalog summary
Overview: The CA-410 Display Color Analyzer is a high-speed, high-accuracy instrument designed for modern display measurement needs, featuring advanced probes suitable for automatic system integration.
Specifications: Utilizes XYZ filters for chromaticity measurements aligned with CIE 1931 functions, supporting a wide luminance range for OLED and HDR displays.
Probes: Offers normal, high-sensitivity, and high-luminance probes for various display sizes and types, from smartwatches to large TVs.
Integration and Connectivity: Designed for seamless integration with motorized zero-calibration, synchronization detection, and USB/RS-232C connectivity, compatible with previous models.
Performance: Provides high-speed measurements for processes like gamma testing and inline color adjustments, with modes for faster performance without accuracy loss.
Software Support: CA-S40 software enables data visualization and analysis, supporting luminance, chromaticity, gamma, and flicker measurements, focusing on VRR-Flicker for modern displays.
Flicker Measurement: Incorporates VRR-Flicker method for evaluating flicker in Variable Refresh Rate displays, addressing traditional method limitations.
VRR-Flicker Technology: Allows precise evaluation of flicker patterns, presented at the 28th International Display Workshops.
Probes and Their Capabilities: CA-410 series and CA-527 probes support VRR-Flicker measurement, with specific capabilities for OLED displays at low luminance.
Software Tools: CA-S40 software measures emission waveforms, perceived luminance waveforms, and VRR-Flicker values, showing flicker variation over time.
Safety and Certifications: KONICA MINOLTA holds ISO certifications for measuring instruments, advising correct power supply connection to prevent hazards.
Recommended Instruments: Lists probe models recommended for DisplayHDR™ Certification.
Accessories and Connectivity: Includes cables, accessories for probe connection, and optional items like carrying cases and batteries.
Conclusion: Provides a comprehensive overview of tools and technologies for measuring and evaluating flicker in display technologies, emphasizing accurate measurement for quality assessment.
